Check convergence and mixing of a fit

Source: R/diagnose.R
diagnose.Rd

summary() with every observed cell included and a verdict. Rank-normalised R-hat, bulk and tail effective sample sizes (ESS) and Monte Carlo standard errors are computed for every parameter: the hyperparameters (from the full trace after burn-in), the fixed effects, and the latent prevalence of every observed cell, nugget included (from the stored draws; this is not the nugget-free surface of predict()). A fit passes only if all are acceptable. Hyperparameters can look converged while the latent cells mix poorly, so the latent cells are always checked.

Usage

diagnose(
  fit,
  rhat_max = 1.05,
  ess_theta_min = 400,
  ess_latent_median_min = 100
)

Arguments

fit

A fit_areal() object.

rhat_max

Largest acceptable R-hat, for every parameter.

ess_theta_min

Smallest acceptable bulk ESS of each hyperparameter and each fixed effect.

ess_latent_median_min

Smallest acceptable median bulk ESS over the observed cells.

Value

A summary.stareal_fit (see summary()) with the latent rows, and checks (a data frame: check, value, threshold, pass), pass (TRUE if every check passes) and latent (a few statistics over the cells).

Examples

fr <- areal_lattice(4, 4)
tf <- time_frame(n_steps = 5)
sim <- simulate_areal(fr, tf, n_cells = 30, seed = 1)
fit <- fit_areal(sim, control = list(n_iter = 100, n_burn = 50, n_store = 25, n_chains = 2,
                                     n_cores = 1, ess_sweeps = 2, verbose = FALSE))
suppressWarnings(diagnose(fit))   # far too short to pass
#> <stareal_fit summary> 30 observed cells; 2 chains, 50 iterations after burn-in
#>   hyperparameters from the trace (100 draws), fixed effects and cells from the 50 stored draws
#> 
#>   variable   mean    sd   q2.5    q50 q97.5  rhat ess_bulk ess_tail

#>      rho_t  0.859 0.091  0.623  0.874 0.977 1.431        5       19
#>    sigma_n  0.309 0.132  0.129  0.277 0.579 1.070       26       53
#>  intercept -0.549 0.681 -1.950 -0.556 0.768 1.027       38       34
#>      trend  0.956 0.368  0.446  0.966 1.600 1.114       20       56
#> 
#> acceptance after burn-in: centred 0.17, surrogate 0.20; 0.000675 s per iteration

#>

#>   latent R-hat (max)              1.2  <= 1.05   FAIL
